'''Tyla Gallamby''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] scientist who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Imperial High Command has summoned me to the Executor for yet another debriefing. I told them all I know. The virus somehow escaped. It was probably an accident.|Tyla Gallamby, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ID" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tyla Gallamby was working at an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, the Empire was conducting secret and dangerous scientific research, intending to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] in order to create super soldiers.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an accident happened at the Imperial Research Facility and resulted in the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]]. Most of the Imperial staff was killed and became flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. Luckily, Gallamby survived the attack of the creatures and finally managed to escape the area, avoiding containment into the promptly-established [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]]. The woman later reported the situation to her superiors but [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] summoned her to the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] for debriefing.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> In fact, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself was very concerned by the outbreak and was reluctant to accept that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] was not involved in the accident.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> Tyla Gallamby and other people, such as [[Tk-216]] and [[Illrian Nhagy]], were still present near the Quarantine Zone, awaiting evaluation out of the planet, when independent spacers started to arrive on Dathomir to investigate the outbreak.<ref name="SWG:ID" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyla Gallamby appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ID" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tyla Gallamby was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]", released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:ID" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
